description: ORs the incoming value byte into the first, second, third and fifth bitplane bytes and ANDs the mask byte into the fourth plane at the same position. Planes are 8000 bytes apart.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:0FF8
name: write_pixel_bits_00011
description: ORs the incoming value byte into the fourth and fifth bitplane bytes and ANDs the mask byte into the first, second and third planes at the same position. Planes are 8000 bytes apart.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:100C
name: write_pixel_bits_10011
description: ORs the incoming value byte into the first, fourth and fifth bitplane bytes and ANDs the mask byte into the second and third planes at the same position. Planes are 8000 bytes apart.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:1020
name: write_pixel_bits_01011_alt
description: ORs the incoming value byte into the second, fourth and fifth bitplane bytes and ANDs the mask byte into the first and third planes at the same position. Planes are 8000 bytes apart.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:1034
name: write_pixel_bits_11011_alt
description: ORs the incoming value byte into the first, second, fourth and fifth bitplane bytes and ANDs the mask byte into the third plane at the same position. Planes are 8000 bytes apart.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:1048
name: write_pixel_bits_00111
description: ORs the incoming value byte into the third, fourth and fifth bitplane bytes and ANDs the mask byte into the first and second planes at the same position. Planes are 8000 bytes apart.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:105C
name: write_pixel_bits_10111
description: ORs the incoming value byte into the first, third, fourth and fifth bitplane bytes and ANDs the mask byte into the second plane at the same position. Planes are 8000 bytes apart.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:1070
name: write_pixel_bits_01111_alt
description: ORs the incoming value byte into the second, third, fourth and fifth bitplane bytes and ANDs the mask byte into the first plane at the same position. Planes are 8000 bytes apart.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:1084
name: write_pixel_bits_11111_alt
description: ORs the incoming value byte into all five bitplane bytes at the same position, with no mask applied. Planes are 8000 bytes apart.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:1118
name: blit_rect_copy_with_shift
description: Programs the blitter registers for a rectangle copy from source to destination, with a bit shift taken from the x position. Zero high parameter bits select a plain copy mode, otherwise a masked mode is set, and the routine then issues one blit per row before a final call.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:128C
name: wait_for_blitter_idle
description: Spins until the blitter busy flag clears, reading the status byte at the address register plus two. It returns once the blitter is idle, so the caller can safely reprogram its registers.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:12BE
name: run_stages_skip_empty_rect
description: Makes a first call, then a second call only when both size parameters are positive, then a final call. The middle step is skipped for zero-sized rectangles.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:12F8
name: blit_five_passes_by_parity
description: Programs the blitter for five passes over a set of rows, computing the word width and bit shift from its arguments and loading the first-word mask and modulo registers. On each pass it chooses one of two control words from the low bit of a value returned by a call, then writes the size register to start the blit.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:1378
name: release_blitter_ownership
description: Calls the graphics library DisownBlitter routine through the stored library base and returns its result. It gives exclusive use of the blitter back to the system.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:137E
name: acquire_blitter_ownership
description: Calls the graphics library OwnBlitter routine through the stored library base and returns its result. It takes exclusive control of the blitter, the counterpart of releasing it.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:1394
name: dispatch_indexed_entry_with_mask
description: Looks up an entry in an offset table by index when the index is in range, then advances a data pointer for each set bit of a five-bit mask word. It finishes by calling one other routine with the entry's position, size and flags.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:1428
name: draw_masked_sprite_bytes
description: Draws a masked sprite into the five 320 by 200 bitplanes starting at a byte column given by the x position, with the mask stored after the five planes. Where a mask byte is all ones the sprite bytes are copied straight across, and elsewhere the masked bits are cleared before the sprite bits are ORed in.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:14A8
name: draw_masked_sprite_byte_rows
description: Continues the masked sprite drawing loop from a jump point, copying bytes across the five planes when the mask is all ones and otherwise clearing and ORing bits per byte. It is a second entry into the same drawing logic as its neighbour, reached with the row state already set.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:14D4
name: draw_masked_sprite_longwords
description: Draws a masked sprite across five bitplanes using 32-bit words, 2000 words per plane, with the mask stored after the planes. It copies the sprite word where the mask is all ones and otherwise clears the masked bits before ORing in the sprite bits.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:1536
name: draw_masked_sprite_per_row
description: Draws a masked sprite row by row using 32-bit words, copying the sprite words where the mask is all ones and otherwise clearing masked bits before ORing in the sprite bits. It is a row-oriented sibling of the long-word masked draw next to it.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:155A
name: combine_planes_into_mask
description: ORs the five bitplanes together, 2000 words at a time, and writes the result to the buffer that follows them. This builds a combined occupancy mask from the planes.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:1588
name: blit_clipped_sprite_rows
description: Clips a sprite against the 320-pixel screen and the row range, then programs the blitter registers for its rows. Each row selects one of two blitter control words from a bit of an argument before starting the blit.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:1590
name: add_to_pointer_if_nonzero
description: Adds the incoming value to the longword at the address register, but only when that longword is non-zero. Zero entries are left untouched, so the routine acts as a conditional relocation step.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:19:159A
name: adjust_pointer_offsets
description: Calls four setup routines, then walks a list of entries and, for each one whose negative-flag field is set, adds the entry base address to the pointers that follow it. It finishes with a further call and returns its result when a flag is set.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:0000
name: tick_three_step_divider
description: Stores a pending value into a global when it is non-negative, clears a counter, and calls three routines. When a flag is set it counts a three-step divider down and calls one more routine each time the count reaches zero, resetting the divider to 3.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:004C
name: decode_eight_pixels_into_planes
description: Reads eight pixel indices, each looked up in a 16-entry table, and builds five separate bitplane bytes from bits zero to four of the table entries. It stores the results in the global block and returns bit five of the last entry.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:009E
name: toggle_bit_and_step_random
description: Toggles one bit in a byte at the first pointer and clears masked bits in a byte at the second pointer. It then advances a 32-bit feedback generator by one step, folding in a feedback constant when the top bit shifts out, and returns the value with its two 16-bit halves swapped.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:00A2
name: advance_lfsr_seed_swapped
description: Advances the same 32-bit feedback generator one step and returns the new value with its halves swapped. It is the plain generator step, without the bit operations of its neighbour.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:00B8
name: forward_to_one_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns with no other work. It is a plain forwarding entry.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:00C2
name: blit_clipped_masked_sprite
description: Clips a sprite to the screen, then programs the blitter's first-word and last-word masks, modulos and pointers. It waits for the blitter to be free before each row, then runs one blit per row with a control word chosen by a bit of an argument.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:028C
name: execute_infinite_loop
description: Loops forever with no exit, so it halts execution at this point. It is reached only through a gap in the code, so it acts as a trap rather than real behaviour.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:029C
name: update_copper_list_pointer
description: Clears a pending copper-list flag after calling one routine when it is set, then stores a copper list address in the global block. It touches the copper list high-pointer register, so it prepares the display list.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:02E6
name: start_copper_list_if_pending
description: If a pending flag is set, calls the routine that points the copper at a new list and clears the flag, then stores the list address in the global block. Its flow matches its neighbour, differing only in the copper start call.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:032E
name: compute_display_window_copper_words
description: Computes a vertical display window start from a stored line value, offset by a fixed 44 lines, and uses decimal 201 when the input flag is zero. It packs the result into a pair of copper move words for the display window registers.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:0346
name: pack_display_window_copper_words
description: Packs a vertical display window start and an input value into a pair of copper move words, using the same offset of 44 lines as its neighbour. It takes the horizontal value from a register rather than a global flag.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:0374
name: copy_words_into_strided_table
description: Copies 32 words from the source pointer into a table with a stride of two words, writing each value four times to the same slots. The four destination pointers start together and advance together, so the repeated writes land on the same entries.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:03AC
name: write_copper_list_plane_pointers
description: Writes fixed copper instruction words and then fills the high and low halves of five bitplane addresses at 8000-byte spacing into a copper list. It stores the list pointer afterwards and finishes by reading the copper jump strobe register.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:0520
name: copy_sixteen_words_to_table
description: Copies sixteen 16-bit words from the source pointer into a fixed table in memory, one word at a time.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:0544
name: copy_sixteen_words_second_table
description: Copies sixteen 16-bit words from the source pointer into a second fixed table, using the same copy loop as its neighbour.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:0574
name: halt_in_infinite_loop
description: Loops forever with no exit and does nothing else. It is reached only through a gap in the code, so it stands in for a halt.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:0584
name: clear_table_and_reset_counters
description: Zeroes a 32-word table, stores the incoming register value in a global, and sets two other globals to fixed values, decimal 4095 and 15.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:05C4
name: clear_self_block_set_globals
description: Zeroes 32 words of memory starting at the address the listing gives for this routine, then sets two globals to fixed values, decimal 4095 and 15. The cleared block overlaps the routine's own region, so it looks like a self-clearing step.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:05F6
name: wait_for_status_top_bit
description: Busy-waits while a status byte at a fixed address has its top bit clear, and returns once that bit is set. It is a synchronisation spin used before the next step.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:0602
name: fade_palette_step
description: When a counter byte is non-negative, it decrements the counter and subtracts a fade value from the red, green and blue nibbles of 32 colour words, clamped at zero. Each step then lowers the fade value by decimal 273 and calls one other routine.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:0674
name: copy_sixteen_longs_set_counter
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit words from the source pointer into a fixed table, then sets a counter byte to decimal 17.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:068C
name: wait_for_counter_negative
description: Busy-waits while a counter byte is non-negative and returns once it goes negative. It paces the caller until a countdown finishes.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:0698
name: decrement_colour_nibbles
description: When its counter byte is non-negative, it decrements the counter, calls one routine, and then lowers each non-zero low, middle and high nibble of 32 colour words by one. The top nibble of each word is left unchanged.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:06FC
name: rotate_five_word_ring
description: Rotates a ring of five 16-bit words by one position, moving the first value to the end, then calls one other routine.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:0700
name: rotate_five_word_ring_b
description: Rotates the same five-word ring by one position and calls one other routine. It is identical to its neighbour.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:0704
name: rotate_five_word_ring_c
description: Rotates the same five-word ring by one position and calls one other routine. Its body matches the neighbouring rotations.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:070A
name: release_blitter_via_base
description: Calls the graphics library DisownBlitter routine through the stored library base and returns. It releases the blitter back to the system.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:23:0710
name: acquire_blitter_via_base
description: Calls the graphics library OwnBlitter routine through the stored library base and returns. It claims the blitter for exclusive use.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:11:0000
name: set_flag_to_one
description: Stores the value 1 into a global flag and returns. Three callers use it, so it likely sets a ready or enabled state.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:11:000A
name: return_immediately_entry
description: Returns at once without any work. It is an empty entry point reached from a table.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:11:000C
name: return_no_work_entry
description: Returns without doing anything. It is an empty entry that a handler table points at.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:11:000E
name: return_no_work_entry_b
description: Returns without doing anything. It is an empty entry that a handler table points at.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:11:0010
name: return_no_work_gap_stub
description: An empty routine in an unreferenced gap of the code, so it does nothing and simply returns.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:11:0014
name: call_routine_if_slot_set
description: Tests a longword at offset decimal 2882 in the block held by the address register. It calls one other routine and returns that result when the longword is non-zero, and returns 0 otherwise.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:11:002C
name: return_immediately
description: Performs no operations and returns control to the caller at once. It is an empty entry point.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:11:0038
name: return_no_work_entry_c
description: Returns without doing anything. It is an empty entry that a handler table points at.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:11:003A
name: return_gap_stub_b
description: An empty routine in an unreferenced gap of the code, so it does nothing and simply returns.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:11:004E
name: return_no_work_entry_d
description: Returns without doing anything. It is an empty entry that a handler table points at.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:11:0050
name: return_gap_stub_c
description: An empty routine in an unreferenced gap of the code, so it does nothing and simply returns.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:11:005A
name: return_no_work_entry_e
description: Returns without doing anything. It is an empty entry that a handler table points at.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:11:005E
name: clear_global_flag
description: Stores 0 into a global flag and returns. Three callers use it, so it likely clears a ready or enabled state.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:11:006E
name: configure_state_from_record
description: When a global byte and a record pointer are both set, it clears bit 0 at a byte pointer and copies a state byte from the record, setting or clearing bit 1 according to a record flag. It also copies a second record byte into a global, sets two more globals, calls one other routine, and then sets bit 0 at the byte pointer again.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0000
name: seek_file_and_return_result
description: Calls the DOS Seek routine twice through the library jump table, then calls two other routines and returns the value from the last of them. It positions an open file before the following step.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:004E
name: poll_event_and_flag_status
description: Repeats the same polling sequence as its counterpart in another hunk: it polls through a library jump table, loops until an event arrives, reads a status value, and sets a flag when that value equals decimal 27. It returns the poll result, or -1 when that result is not positive.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0166
name: seek_then_read_block
description: Seeks to a position when the incoming offset is zero or positive, then calls the DOS read routine through the library jump table. It is a seek-and-read step for loading file data.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:019A
name: seek_then_write_block
description: Seeks to a position when the incoming offset is zero or positive, then calls the DOS write routine through the library jump table. It is the write counterpart of its neighbouring seek-and-read routine.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:01E4
name: return_global_if_call_ok
description: Calls one other routine and returns a stored global value when the call result is non-zero, otherwise it returns 0.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:020C
name: allocate_memory_into_free_slot
description: Scans 50 eight-byte slots for a free one and returns 50 when none is free. Otherwise it calls the system memory allocation routine, stores its result and the incoming value in the free slot, and returns the stored result.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0270
name: free_memory_and_clear_slot
description: Scans 50 eight-byte slots for the entry matching the pointer in the address register, and for each match calls the system memory-free routine and clears the slot. It releases blocks that were recorded in the table earlier.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:02C0
name: return_gap_stub_d
description: An empty routine in an unreferenced gap of the code, so it does nothing and simply returns.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:02C6
name: free_all_table_allocations
description: Walks all 50 eight-byte slots and, for every slot that holds an allocation, calls the system memory-free routine and clears the slot. It releases everything recorded in the table at once.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:031C
name: store_pointer_in_state_block
description: Stores the incoming longword in a state-block field at decimal offset 11584. It records a pointer that later routines write through.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0328
name: forward_to_one_routine_b
description: Calls one other routine and returns with no other work. It is a plain forwarding entry.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:032E
name: append_byte_to_output_cursor
description: Writes a byte at the current position of a cursor kept in the state block, advances the cursor by one, and writes a zero byte just past it. It builds a zero-terminated byte string one character at a time.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0350
name: call_span_routine_from_entry
description: Passes a leading long word, a 16-bit start field and an inclusive length to one other routine, with the length computed as the end field minus the start field plus one. Eight callers share this span-passing wrapper.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:038C
name: store_two_words_in_state
description: Stores the two incoming 16-bit register values into fields at byte offsets 4 and 6 of the structure referenced from the state block.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:03AA
name: interpolate_positions_over_frames
description: On its first call it sets up three working buffers, computes the absolute difference and direction of each coordinate pair and the largest difference, then derives per-step increments. On later calls it advances each value by its increment across a fixed frame count, returning 1 while still moving and returning 0 with a restart flag set once the count is exhausted.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0412
name: compute_interpolation_steps
description: Computes per-element absolute differences and direction flags between two coordinate arrays, tracks the largest difference, and then runs the same step logic as its neighbour. It is the setup half of the interpolation, entered with the arrays already in registers.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:043E
name: start_interpolation_countdown
description: Sets each per-element increment from the largest difference, resets the frame countdown, and then either finishes or advances the values one step. It is the shared tail of the interpolation routines.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0462
name: advance_interpolation_step
description: Resets the restart flag and frame countdown, and when the countdown runs out it calls three routines, sets the restart flag and returns 0. Otherwise it adds each increment to its value, pulls back any overshoot, and returns 1.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:04A2
name: step_interpolated_values
description: Adds each element's increment to its current value and, when a value overshoots the largest difference, pulls it back and applies the direction correction. It always returns 1.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:04EA
name: return_one_stub
description: Returns the value 1 without doing anything else. Two callers use it, so it acts as an always-true result.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:04F2
name: copy_pair_to_pointer_list
description: Copies a pair of longwords from the parameter into every destination pointer in a null-terminated list passed on the stack, then returns 0.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0524
name: update_seed_return_high_bits
description: Takes a value from one routine, adds the constant decimal 12345 and stores the sum as a seed in the state block. It returns the high 15 bits of that sum, behaving like a seeded pseudo-random step.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0546
name: store_random_seed_word
description: Stores the incoming 16-bit value into the seed field of the state block. It is the companion to the routine that advances that seed.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0558
name: select_table_entry_and_toggle
description: Reads a 32-bit entry from a table indexed by a stored index, writes it through the pointer in the address register and into a state field, then toggles a bit-flag byte. It writes the entry again to a second field and finishes by calling two other routines.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:055E
name: compare_state_bytes_differ
description: Returns 1 when the two state bytes at offsets 2881 and 2880 differ, and 0 when they match.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0564
name: run_stages_skip_empty_b
description: Makes a first call, then a second call only when both size parameters are positive, then a final call. It repeats the staged pattern of its neighbouring routine.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:056A
name: allocate_sized_buffer_with_header
description: Releases any pending buffer recorded in the state block, then, if the requested size is non-zero, allocates a block through another routine and stores the size plus 2 in its first word. It returns the address just past that word, or 0 when the request is empty or the allocation fails.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0570
name: initialise_pointers_and_request_pass
description: Copies a longword from one state field into two others, then calls one routine with a pointer and two values from the state block, and calls a second routine with two more state pointers.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0576
name: read_pair_into_globals
description: Clears three state globals, then reads a value through one routine and, when that value is non-negative, reads two more and stores them. It returns a packed pair of results, using decimal 65535 as a sentinel when a read yields zero and -1 when the first read fails.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:057C
name: build_path_with_separators
description: Builds a file path by appending a volume colon when one is missing and a separator character when the last character does not already end a path part. It then optionally adds a trailing dot and calls one other routine.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0582
name: select_display_layout_preset
description: Chooses one of a series of display layout presets from a mode number, setting position and size fields in the state block, then calls routines to apply each preset. The bundle truncates the code partway through the mode cases, so later presets are not visible.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0588
name: multiply_longwords_low_half
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values by splitting each into 16-bit halves and summing the cross products. It returns the low 32 bits of the product.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:058E
name: spin_forever_gap_stub
description: Loops forever with no exit and is reached only through a gap in the code. It acts as a trap rather than real behaviour.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:0594
name: read_next_ring_entry
description: Waits until a poll routine returns non-zero, then returns the next word from a 100-entry ring table and advances its read index, wrapping back to zero after entry 99.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:10:059A
name: record_block_for_later_free
description: When given a non-zero block pointer, calls one routine and records the header two bytes before that pointer as a pending free. The allocator releases the recorded block on a later call.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:0000
name: shutdown_interrupts_and_library
description: Writes a stored value into a field of an interrupt structure and marks it active, then calls the system routines that remove the interrupt server and close the library. It tears down the setup done by its initialisation counterpart.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:0096
name: initialise_system_and_interrupts
description: Opens the graphics and intuition libraries, compares available memory against decimal 202446 to set a flag, records the current task and related state, and adds an interrupt server. It returns 0 once setup is complete.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:0218
name: rotate_five_word_ring_d
description: Rotates the same five-word ring by one position and calls one other routine. It matches its neighbouring ring rotations.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:024A
name: select_entry_and_toggle_b
description: Reads a 32-bit entry from a table indexed by a stored index, writes it through the pointer in the address register, and toggles a bit-flag byte. It writes the entry again and finishes with two other calls, matching its neighbour.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:0290
name: select_entry_and_toggle_c
description: Reads a 32-bit entry from a table indexed by a stored index, writes it through the pointer in the address register, and toggles a bit-flag byte. It writes the entry again and finishes with two other calls, matching its neighbour.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:02D6
name: wait_for_status_field_equal
description: Busy-waits until bits eight to sixteen of a status longword equal the register value shifted into those bits, then returns. It synchronises with a value that a status longword updates.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:02F8
name: return_gap_stub_e
description: An empty routine in an unreferenced gap of the code, so it does nothing and simply returns.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:02FE
name: wait_while_status_field_below
description: Busy-waits while bits eight to sixteen of a status longword are below the register value shifted into those bits, and returns once they reach it.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:0326
name: toggle_flag_and_return_entry
description: Toggles a bit-flag byte and returns the 32-bit table entry selected by the stored index. The index itself is not changed by the toggle.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:033E
name: return_other_table_entry
description: Returns the 32-bit table entry at the index opposite to the stored one, selecting the other of two alternating buffers.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:0356
name: return_current_table_entry
description: Returns the 32-bit table entry selected by the stored index, without changing any state.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:0368
name: push_value_into_ring
description: Stores a non-zero 16-bit value in a 100-entry ring buffer and advances the write index, wrapping after entry 99. It skips the store when the ring is full or the value is zero.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:03A6
name: ring_has_pending_values
description: Returns 1 when the ring buffer's read index differs from its write index, meaning at least one value is waiting, and 0 when it is empty.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:03B8
name: read_ring_entry_b
description: Waits until a poll routine returns non-zero, then returns the next word from a 100-entry ring table and advances its read index, wrapping after entry 99. It matches its neighbouring ring reader.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:03EC
name: set_mode_flags_from_state
description: Copies two global words into fields at decimal offsets 6166 and 6168 of the state block. It then sets a flag at offset 6164 when the mode field at offset 11588 equals 1, and a byte at offset 6165 to 2 when the mode equals 2, otherwise 0.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:044A
name: run_two_update_steps
description: Calls two other routines in sequence and returns. It is a paired update step used by its callers.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:0466
name: run_two_update_steps_b
description: Calls two other routines in sequence and returns, identical to its neighbour.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:0482
name: forward_to_one_routine_c
description: Calls one other routine and returns with no other work.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:049C
name: write_copper_plane_pointers_b
description: Writes fixed copper words and fills the high and low halves of five bitplane addresses at 8000-byte spacing, matching its counterpart. It stores the list pointer and returns a value read from the copper jump strobe register.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04A2
name: notify_linked_entries_with_changes
description: Walks a linked list of entries starting at decimal offset 5524 in the state block. For each entry whose flag bit is set and whose bit 2 is clear, where two stored 16-bit values differ, it calls one other routine, and it finishes with one more call.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04A8
name: copy_words_strided_table_b
description: Copies 32 words into a strided table, writing each word four times to the same slots, matching its neighbour.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04AE
name: wait_for_counter_negative_b
description: Busy-waits while the counter byte is non-negative and returns once it goes negative, matching its neighbouring wait.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04B4
name: conditional_call_then_finish
description: Calls one routine only when a global flag byte is non-zero, then always calls a second routine and returns.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04BA
name: initialise_paired_state_objects
description: Allocates or looks up two state entries through routines and stores them in fields at decimal offsets 12012 and 12016. It then sets a pointer chain and a byte of decimal 91, and calls routines to finish setup, which looks like initialisation of a small paired object.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04C0
name: update_copper_list_pointer_b
description: Clears a pending copper-list flag after calling one routine when it is set, then stores a copper list address in the global block. It matches its neighbouring copper routine.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04C6
name: update_copper_list_pointer_c
description: Clears a pending copper-list flag after calling one routine when it is set, then stores a copper list address in the global block. It matches its neighbouring copper routine.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04CC
name: clear_table_reset_counters_b
description: Zeroes a 32-word table, stores the incoming value in a global, and sets two other globals to decimal 4095 and 15, matching its neighbour.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04D2
name: tick_three_step_divider_b
description: Stores a pending value into a global when it is non-negative, clears a counter, and calls three routines, with the three-step divider logic of its neighbour.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04D8
name: copy_sixteen_longs_counter_b
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit words from the source pointer into a fixed table and sets a counter byte to decimal 17, matching its neighbour.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04DE
name: spin_forever_gap_stub_b
description: Loops forever with no exit and is reached only through a gap in the code. It acts as a trap rather than real behaviour.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04E4
name: allocate_memory_free_slot_b
description: Scans 50 eight-byte slots for a free one and returns 50 when none is free. Otherwise it calls the system memory allocation routine, stores its result and the incoming value in the free slot, and returns the stored result.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04EA
name: call_map_status_result
description: Calls one routine and, when its result is zero, makes a second call and returns 0. When the result is non-zero it makes a different call and returns -1.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04F0
name: set_field_and_call_library
description: Sets a 16-bit field to decimal 10 in a structure referenced by the state block, stores a pointer to its own field, then calls one library routine through the jump table.
